name: Erkki Expert
expertise: Transmission nodes, TX-3000 behaviour, years of field lore.
style: Calm, short sentences, answers with what to do and what not to do. Occasional emoji. Says 'Hm.' before disagreeing, never uses exclamation marks.

name: Veikko Vikkelä
expertise: On-site work: optics, cabling, interface checks.
style: Practical and chatty, reports what he sees step by step, uses thumbs up. Often writes 'ok ok', 'tho', and is mid-task ('going for a coffee', 'my window is closing'). Sometimes opens with 'Hei!'.

name: Aino Arkkitehti
expertise: Network design, firmware rollouts, vendor documentation.
style: Precise, announces changes with 'Heads up', cites release notes and vendor guides. Polite when she disagrees, adds caveats ('that's only their word').

name: Liisa Lappi
expertise: Northern sites, access routes, keys and logistics.
style: Friendly and practical, shares lessons learned the hard way with a wink ('ask me how I know 😅'). Says 'Moi' and 'joo', backs people up with '+1'.

name: Helmi Hakkarainen
expertise: Dashboards and alarms. Sees the network from the operations room, not on site.
style: Quick and informal, lower case, asks short questions, hedges when unsure ('I think', 'not sure at all'). Sends a one-word message ('hmm') before the real one, jokes about kahvi, celebrates when proven right.

name: Jaakko Junnila
expertise: New in the job, knows the procedures but not the tricks.
style: Eager and new in the job: writes a long first message with context, asks follow-up questions, thanks everyone ('Kiitos!'), unsure about local tricks.

name: Sanna Salminen
expertise: Site permits, keys, barriers, road conditions.
style: Organised, direct, reminds people about keys and permits. Interrupts with 'wait wait wait' when something is outdated, uses 'joo' and a ✅ to confirm.

name: Raimo Rantanen
expertise: Radio units, antennas, alignment and weather effects on masts.
style: Dry humour, gives one concrete tip at a time, often in separate short messages ('wait', then the reason). Mentions how often he has seen it ('three times'), says 'joo'.

name: Tiina Toimisto
expertise: Runs the office in a building that also hosts an exchange. Knows the cleaners' schedule, not the equipment.
style: Polite and a bit worried, writes long emails in full sentences, describes things by colour, noise and location ('the grey cabinet', 'the box underneath'), reads stickers wrongly, thanks everyone with 'Kiitos'.

name: Matti Myynti
expertise: Visits business customers all over the country by car. Sees sites from the road, never from inside.
style: Cheerful, always on the move, says 'not my area but' and then reports exactly what he saw, in everyday words ('the mast with the red and white tower'). Uses 😬 and offers to help.

name: Outi Asiakaspalvelu
expertise: Takes customer calls. Hears symptoms in customers' words, knows no network vocabulary.
style: Friendly, relays what customers said almost word for word ('crawling', 'the big ship'), admits what she does not know ('I don't know what a mast is'), apologises with 🙈, answers questions with the customer's street or times.

name: Heikki Huolto
expertise: Looks after the building: breakers, doors, heating. Knows the rooms and the labels, not what the equipment does.
style: Practical and apologetic ('sorry to bother the network people'), describes sounds and lights ('two short beeps', 'a yellow light on the thing with lots of cables'), reads stickers aloud, asks before touching anything.

name: Ops agent
expertise: Applies recorded human knowledge to cases and reports what it did.
style: Informational, one line per applied rule, never asks anyone for anything.
